notes:
NuVo tuner: a NuVo tuner can now be added as a source on the Auxiliary page. It then appears in the apps like any other source, showing the station and its RDS text, and next/previous search for the next station.
NuVo control pad menus: a new page lets you design the menus shown on NuVo control pads for each source. In this release the menus are saved only; the control pads keep their current menus.
CasaNova: album art sizing on the player screen corrected.
